sources.twoWayMethods: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 6.5.5.1.1 (p. 949): the direct design method of Sec 6.5.6 or the equivalent frame method of Sec 6.5.7
sources.directDesign.limits: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 6.5.6.1.1-6.5.6.1.6, Eq 6.6.82 (pp. 950-951): three spans, 2 : 1 panels, spans within one third, column offsets 10 %, gravity load with L <= 2D, 0.2 <= αf1 l2² / αf2 l1² <= 5
sources.directDesign.distribution: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 6.5.6.3, Table 6.6.4 (p. 952): 0.65 / 0.35 in interior spans and the end span shares
sources.directDesign.transfer: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 6.5.6.3.6 (p. 953): 0.3 Mo to an edge column; Sec 6.5.6.9.2, Eq 6.6.87 (p. 956)
sources.directDesign.modification: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 6.5.6.7 (p. 955): 10 % if Mo is kept
sources.equivalentFrame: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 6.5.7.2-6.5.7.7, Eq 6.6.88 (pp. 956-960): slab-beams with Is/(1 - c2/l2)² to the column centre, equivalent columns with torsional members, live load patterns of 3/4 L when L > 0.75 D, face moments not farther than 0.175 l1; C by Eq 6.6.86 (p. 953); a wall across at least 0.75 l2 taken as fixing the slab-beam as the uniform distribution of Sec 6.5.6.4.3 (p. 954) takes it
sources.corner: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 6.5.3.6.1-6.5.3.6.4, Figure 6.6.19 (pp. 946-947): top and bottom steel for the largest positive moment over l/5 at exterior corners with edge walls or αf > 1; bars at most 2h apart
sources.openings: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 6.5.4.2.1-6.5.4.2.4 (p. 949): openings in slabs without beams
